versions.guide:
Find the key

The door to the storerooms is locked. Find the key that opens it.

Use the key

To open the door, activate the altar in the northwestern room.

Retrieve the armor

The armor lies in a sarcophagus in the eastern room.

Joon Armor

Wise Tui-Len has uncovered the secret of the cave in the Valley of Two Rivers. The Joons hid one of their heroes' suits of armor there and enchanted the place using an ancient amulet. The spell has now been lifted, and the armor can be recovered.
